scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('functions')) { fs.rmSync('functions', { recursive: true, force: true }); }"
scripts.build: next build --webpack && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('out')) { fs.mkdirSync('.vercel/output', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('out', '.vercel/output/static', { recursive: true, force: true }); }"
